# Archives written at records schema 4

These immutable fixtures preserve the bytes written before the records schema 5 lifecycle
migration. Later builds must restore these archives, rather than regenerating them (SPEC
section 12). The schema-2 and schema-3 fixtures remain unchanged.

## Writer and files

The writer was `write_archive_fixtures` in `crates/storage/tests/archive_fixtures.rs` at clean
commit `500b86341d7d1077c0c0f2a7de023b80b474dc84`, run on 2026-10-19 with output outside the
repository. It passed: one test, 15.36 seconds; 128.61 seconds including compilation. Both the
live store and the archived database reported `user_version` 4. Data directory format remains
`{"format":"okf-jawn-data","version":1}`. Schema 4 includes the `jobs.sealed` column.

| File | Bytes | SHA-256 | Format |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace.zip` | 364692 | `00d3ac2388defc8319e047c00e5e048e0b26cbf9e52364a81a9d9e93fb216076` | `okf-jawn-workspace-archive`, version 1 |
| `installation.zip` | 948 | `3961c3b8e1fb3e847021008333f93584bbd79c24207649c613e17ace4e17f178` | `okf-jawn-installation-archive`, version 1 |

## Contents

The fixture writer supplies the same synthetic scenario described in the schema-2 README:
workspace content and original objects, retained proposal history, drafts, reviews and scoped
records, with a separate installation archive. No live user data is used. The current writer's
constants and existing restore assertions define the expected content.

The workspace is `b95b4aeb-972e-8632-98bb-10c1fe661a52` in `fixture-tenant`. Its accepted head is
`d7284a1b88edf844520a7ca22581abf2a8942cc2`; its retained proposal candidate is
`1d88d7addfc8d7fb4161dbecaba1f2faa0b0af26`. The tests read those identities from the manifest.
Commit times and installation identities are generated by the writer; these fixed archive
bytes, not a later invocation, are the fixture.

## Privacy inspection

Both ZIP containers, all 11 entries and entry names, the SQLite schema and all 103 stored cells,
raw database bytes (including free space), and all 37 Git objects in the pack were inspected
outside the repository. The checks included the writing machine's username, owner name and
email, personal directory and drive paths, and email-shaped text. UTF-8, Latin-1 and both
UTF-16 byte orders and parities were checked. Git enumeration included every packed object,
not only objects reachable from the accepted head. Source archive hashes remained unchanged.

The automatic scan flagged two raw byte sources, the database and its identical copy inside
the ZIP. Those findings were retained and independently adjudicated; the automatic result was
not relabeled as a pass. Four email-shaped matches crossed SQLite field boundaries: synthetic
tenant/UUID values were concatenated with `fixture-editor@fixtures.invalid`. One also included
three preceding record-header serial-type bytes (`55 4b 77`), independently decoded as SQLite
serial types 85, 75 and 119. The database begins at ZIP byte offset 713, and every flagged raw
ZIP match corresponds exactly to the database match. The parsed cells, synthetic identities
and header boundaries account for every candidate. No other address or personal path was
found. The only actual email value is `fixture-editor@fixtures.invalid`.

## Restore checks

Three tests in `archive_fixtures.rs` check schema 4 and the job seal column, restore both
archives by replacement into an empty data directory, and import the workspace archive into
a blank workspace in another tenant. Replacement and import reuse the existing complete
content, record, proposal, history and draft assertions. They do not prove a deployed database
or a schema-5 migration until that later build runs them.
On the pre-V5 build above, the three schema-4 tests first failed because the new fixture files were absent (0 passed, 3 failed, 11.67 seconds including compilation). After adding these inspected archive bytes, all three passed: 8.41 seconds in tests / 9.49 seconds total. The command was:

```text
cargo test --locked --all-features -p okf-jawn-storage --test archive_fixtures the_schema_4_ -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
```
